novelty.justification: The claim's central novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: a "compact, causally-active 'negation direction'" shared across languages but "disrupted by cross-linguistic negation typology," with the same direction potentially repairing negative-concord errors. Searches for "multilingual LLM negation direction activation steering," "cross-lingual negation circuit negative concord," and "causal negation representation transformer" identify Shaitarova and Rinaldi (2021) as the closest work on typology-correlated zero-shot negation-scope transfer, while The Geometry of Multilingual Language Model Representations (2022) and Cross-Lingual Activation Steering for Multilingual Language Models (2026) separately establish language-neutral subspaces and multilingual steering, but none presents the claimed negation-specific operator–typology interaction. Moving from those works to a causally steerable shared logical operator whose failure is systematically determined by negative concord requires a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer, although the individual measurement tools are standard, supporting high rather than paradigm-level novelty.
